geographic_context.summary: Recorded water connection across the gap between Dry Tortugas census coverage and the main Florida/Keys coverage. Both endpoints are exact source boundary vertices, with zero endpoint error. The segment crosses no source component interior. Its offshore-water attribution follows the checked coordinates and official regional geography; no independent global shoreline-intersection test was performed. The 32.235 km length spans census coverage boundaries, not shorelines or a ferry route.

execution_verification.scope: Exact recorded parent/launcher/child PIDs plus the Florida process-owned OS lock. An active PID is excluded only with a different non-Python executable created strictly after its parent-recorded, validated child exit. No full-system command-line inventory or unrecorded-process absence is claimed.

validation_note: All four serial children exited with code 0. The process gate verifies original benchmark processes have exited and the state12 lock is free; it records Windows PID reuse using live executable identity and creation time rather than claiming every numerical PID is absent. Prelaunch suite: 999 passed in 33.13s. Original 115-test summary evidence is preserved; updated summary-only PID-reuse checks: 142 passed in 1.03s, independently reviewed. No numerical code or benchmark run changed. This report independently verifies saved source populations, graph and polygon/link connectivity, artifact hashes, compressed maps and historical evidence. Final browser QA is recorded separately after report generation.

record.viewer_script_syntax: All Florida block viewer, topology viewer and progress scripts passed Node syntax checks.

record.reason: Accept proven Windows PID reuse after a directly waited validated child exit; no benchmark changes or reruns.

limitations: All four targets are first water-policy attempts, run serially; the preserved strict source-topology exception did not solve a plan. This is not a controlled 300-versus-1000 iteration experiment.
Successful inner solves, outer center convergence, final population balance and connectivity under recorded water links are separate outcomes.
Physical polygons remain unchanged. The water connection counts only when both endpoint blocks belong to the same district; multipart ownership never creates a geometric edge.

The single connection joins water-inclusive census coverage in the Dry Tortugas region to main Florida coverage. Its endpoints are not shorelines, a bridge, or a ferry route; official regional attribution is not a global high-resolution shoreline certificate.
The 1% group/root preflight guides link selection; it is not a final population-balance acceptance guarantee. Local rebalancing does not establish a global optimum.

Population and final part-graph traversals were recomputed; full saved polygon components and source endpoint ownership were rechecked. Statewide source-coverage equality reuses the preserved independent exporter audit.
Objective improvement is comparable within each inner pass only. Trace populations are intermediate point assignments before whole-block connectivity repair.
Wall timings include tracing and shared-desktop contention; peak memory is per-process OS peak working set; gzip file sizes do not measure browser memory or network latency.
